data_tool_trajectory.description: Tool names in order; the golden's arguments must be present (extras tolerated); every execute_sql must be SELECT-only; zero expected calls means zero actual calls.

stock_invariant.description: Hero stock references require matched successful structured tool evidence for the correct product and store, with consistent on-hand or shelf/backroom quantities. Recognised stale answer claims also fail. The semantic judge checks final-answer coverage; no particular stock wording is required.

plan_invariant.description: For plan prompts, require hero-product text, a BOPIS/pickup/picking term and P-0420 or a shrink/locked-case term in the final answer; no backlog quantity is checked.

coverage_invariant.description: Coverage answers must name a skilled, unassigned roster candidate whose shift covers the requested window, with no overlapping recorded break or protected assignment, established by matched successful scoped source reads. Do not require a fixed person or trust a tool recommendation. Preserve fixture pending-count and recorded order/unit checks. The semantic judge assesses the actual primary/relief schedule and all other claims.

refusal_invariant.description: For matching HR prompts, require no create/delegate call and an HR, manager, coaching or disciplinary term in the answer; inspect the answer to establish an actual refusal.

bopis_count_invariant.description: On any line naming the hero product, a stated BOPIS order count must be its order count (3) or the store total (9); unit counts stated as orders fail.

read_evidence_invariant.description: Factual cases require an operational read through a supported domain or generic query path, excluding failed reads and writes. An explicitly referenced daily briefing may supply a matched valid completed ActionPlan; nested reads are verified by workflow integration tests and traces, not inferred from the wrapper. Boundary cases allow routing and reads that returned no data; a read that returned records fails them. Identity and approval/write references retain strict trajectories; raw SQL remains read-only and scoped. Answer grounding is checked separately.
